title: Argus journey and invariant coverage ledger
description: One row per technique-catalog entry of an invariant hunting lane. The contract lanes have carried a machine-checked ledger since 4.5.0 and score accordingly; this gives the invariant lanes the same standing, so a class can no longer be dropped by a narrowed brief without leaving a row behind.

lifecycle.description: The entity lifecycle or workflow this class was driven on.

arrangement.description: How the required precondition state was constructed. Required for an executed row whose catalog entry asks for an arranged state; a probe against whatever state happened to exist has no detection power.

evidence.description: Paths to the captured evidence. An executed row without evidence is a gap.

findings.description: Candidate files filed from this class. An empty list is a legitimate clean result.

reason.description: Why the row is not executed. Required for not-applicable and gap. Time pressure is a valid reason to record, never a reason to omit the row.
